hxlist.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit List API. This API is used by both dropdown box and list box widgets.

See hxlistextended.h for the API used by extended list widgets.

typedef HxResult(*) HxListSelectionCallback(HxListSelectionType_t type, int32_t index1, int32_t index2, void *pData)

Prototype for the item selection callback. This function is called when an item is first highlighted within a list box. For a dropdown box, this function is called when the user selects an item, with the item displayed in the dropdown box.

index1 and index2 describe a range of items when the list supports selection of multiple items.

Normally, applications would listen for a kHxListSelected message rather than use this callback.

HxResult HxListAddItem ( HxList_t *  pList,
const char *  pText,
int32_t *  pIndex 
)

Add an item to a list.

HxListAddItem adds a new item to a dropdown box or list box.

An item is a null-terminated string with an optional image.

The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the item should be inserted. If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to the list. The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the outgoing pIndex.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
pText IN: Null-terminated string
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxListAddSelectableItem ( HxList_t *  pList,
const char *  pText,
int32_t *  pIndex,
bool  selectable 
)

Add an selectable/unselectable item to a list.

HxListAddSelectableItem adds a new item to a dropdown box or list box.

An item is a null-terminated string with an optional image.

The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the item should be inserted. If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to the list. The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the outgoing pIndex.

Set the selectable flag to false when adding an item that is not intended to be selected, such as a section header under which selectable items are grouped.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
pText IN: Null-terminated string
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
selectable IN: flag determining if item is selectable or not
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR is a memory error occurs.

HxResult HxListGetItem ( HxList_t *  pList,
int32_t  index,
char *  pBuffer,
int32_t *  pSize 
)

Lookup an item's string value.

This function returns the string for an item in a dropdown box or list box.

The string is copied into pBuffer. If pBuffer is NULL, then *pSize is set to the length of the item's string, and HX_OK is returned, so that the caller can allocate a buffer of appropriate size for the item's null-terminated string.

The incoming value of *pSize is the size of pBuffer. If pBuffer is too small to hold the string, *pSize is set to the length of the string, and HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL is returned.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
index IN: Index of the item
pBuffer OUT: Pointer to buffer to store the string
pSize IN/OUT: Size of buffer, or size of item's string
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid or if the item's string is NULL.

HxResult HxListGetSelection ( HxList_t *  pList,
int32_t  selectionIndex,
int32_t *  pIndex 
)

Get the current selection.

HxListGetSelection returns the index of the item in a dropdown box or list box that is highlighted. *pIndex is set to kHxListNoSelection if no item is highlighted.

The selectionIndex is the index between 0 and the selected count obtained with HxListGetSelectionCount.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
selectionIndex IN: Index of the selection to get
pIndex OUT: Pointer to the index of highlighted item
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if selectionIndex is out of range.

HxResult HxListRemoveItem ( HxList_t *  pList,
int32_t  index 
)

Remove item from a list.

HxListRemoveItem removes an item from a dropdown box or list box.

HX_INVALID_ARG is returned if index is less than 0. Since the index into the array of list items is zero-based, HX_INVALID_ARG is also returned if index is greater or equal to the number of items in the list.

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
index IN: Index of item to be removed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid.

HxResult HxListSelectItem ( HxList_t *  pList,
int32_t  index,
bool  selected 
)

Set or clear the selection state of an item.

HxListSelectItem sets or clears the selection state of an item on a dropdown box or list box. If selected is true, then the item is highlighted. If selected is false, then the item is not highlighted.

If a new item is selected but is not visible, the list is scrolled appropriately.

NOTE: call to this function will not trigger the kHxListSelected message. This message is only triggered by the UI interaction

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
index IN: Index of item
selected IN: If true, item is highlighted.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index not valid.

HxResult HxListSetSelection ( HxList_t *  pList,
HxListSelectionAttributes_t  attribute,
int32_t  index 
)

Set the current selection.

HxListSetSelection highlights an item in a dropdown box or list box. The zero-based index can be set to kHxListNoSelection if no item should be highlighted.

If the selected item is not visible, the list is scrolled appropriately.

NOTE: call to this function will not trigger the kHxListSelected message. This message is only triggered by the UI interaction

Parameters:
pList IN: Pointer to a list
attribute IN: Type of selection
index IN: Pointer to index of item, or kHxListNoSelection
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is not kHxListNoSelection and is not a valid index. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if item is not selectable.
